text: Binary per-row flag from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): 1 if at least one comment directly addresses the OP in the second person (e.g. 'you', 'your', 'you're' referring to OP, such as 'your view', 'you say', 'you should consider'); 0 if the list is assessable and no comment does. Does not count generic/impersonal 'you' (meaning 'one'/people in general), 'you' inside quoted third-party text or addressed to someone other than OP, or 'you' in quoted OP text unless the commenter themself addresses OP. Excludes moderator/bot notices and any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and stays eligible. Empty valid list gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null; list order is irrelevant.
